tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /gsol 'debs bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun bzhugs so/ /

dngos grub ma lus 'byung ba'i gnas/ /byin rlabs bdud rtsi'i sprin 'khrigs pa'i/ /bla ma kun la skyabs su mchi/ /thugs rje'i spyan gyis gzigs su gsol/ /rnam dag chos sku'i pho brang du/ /kun bzang yab yum la gsol ba 'debs/ /gdod nas gzhi rtsa bral ba yis/ /sems nyid rtogs par byin gyis rlobs/ /'od gsal longs sku'i pho brang du/ /zhi khro rab 'byams la gsol ba 'debs/ /ye nas stong gsal dag pa'i sku/ /lhun grub rtogs par byin gyis rlobs/ /kun khyab sprul sku'i pho brang du/ /rdo rje 'chang la gsol ba 'debs/ /'gags med thugs rje rol pa yis/ /gzhan don rdzogs par byin gyis rlobs/ /gsal stong 'od lnga'i pho brang du/ /rdo rje sems dpa' la gsol ba 'debs/ /gsal snang 'od gsal zhing khams de/ /myur du 'byongs par byin gyis rlobs/ /lhun rdzogs brjod med pho brang du/ /phyag na rdo rje la gsol ba 'debs/ /nyon mongs bdud dpung bar chad dang*/ /rkyen ngan bzlog par byin gyis rlobs/ /'du 'bral med pa'i pho brang du/ /dga' rab rdo rje la gsol ba 'debs/ /gdos bcas sgyu lus phung po 'di/ /'od lus dag par byin gyis rlobs/ /mu bzhi gdal ba'i pho brang du/ /'jam dpal bshes gnyen la gsol ba 'debs/ /phyi nang gzung 'dzin rig pa 'di/ /rang sar grol bar byin gyis rlobs/ /blang dor med pa'i pho brang du/ /shrī sing ha la gsol ba 'debs/ /gtad med rang shar rig pa 'di/ /'dzin med chen por byin gyis rlobs/ /rang gsal gdal ba'i pho brang du/ /dzñā na sū tra la gsol ba 'debs/ /kun khyab gzhi rdzogs lta ba nyid/ /ma btsal rang rdzogs byin gyis rlobs/ /mkhyen rab ye shes pho brang du/ /dri med bshes gnyen la gsol ba 'debs/ /rang babs lhun grub bsgom pa nyid/ /ma btsal rdzogs par byin gyis rlobs/ /rang bzhin dag pa'i pho brang du/ /ting 'dzin bzang po la gsol 'debs/

/ting 'dzin 'od gsal nyi zla nyid/ /gsal 'grib med par byin gyis rlobs/ /tshogs chen yongs rdzogs pho brang du/ /chos rgyal mchog la gsol ba 'debs/ /bsam rdzogs chos sku'i rgyal srid la/ /'gro kun gnas par byin gyis rlobs/ / snying po lhun 'byams pho brang du/ /ldang ma lhun rgyal la gsol ba 'debs/ / sgrib bral cog bzhag dgongs pa nyid/ /yongs rdzogs chen por byin gyis rlobs/ /'od lus dag pa'i pho brang du/ /seng ge dbang phyug la gsol ba 'debs/ /lus sems srid pa'i 'ching ba las/ /tshe 'dir grol bar byin gyis rlobs/ /gzhi klong kun grol pho brang du/ /rgyal ba zhang ston la gsol ba 'debs/ /gnyis 'dzin 'khrul pa'i ri bo 'di/ /rang sar zhig par byin gyis rlobs/ /sna tshogs yon tan gyi pho brang du/ /mkhas pa nyi 'bum la gsol 'debs/ /tshig don chos kyi bdud rtsi yis/ /bdag rgyud dag par byin gyis rlobs/ /gsal stong nyi zla'i pho brang du/ /gu ru jo 'ber la gsol ba 'debs/ /'chi ba rjes dran bskul ma yis/ /dam chos 'grub par byin gyis rlobs/ /gzung 'dzin rang grol gyi pho brang du/ /'khrul zhig chen po la gsol ba 'debs/ /sna tshogs 'khrul ba'i bag chags sprin/ /rang sar dengs par byin gyis rlobs/ /rtsol bral nyag gcig pho brang du/ /zla ba mun sel la gsol 'debs/ /byar med rang babs gnas lugs la/ /rang gnas chen po byin gyis rlobs/ /rtogs pa nam mkha'i pho brang du/ /ku ma rā dza la gsol ba 'debs/ /phyogs med ri khrod dben gnas su/ /rang ngo shes par byin gyis rlobs/ /ye grol chos nyid pho brang du/ /dri med 'od zer la gsol ba 'debs/ /yangs dog med pa'i rigs pa 'di/ /phyogs lhung bral bar byin gyis rlobs/ /rang sems dad mos kyi pho brang du/ /rtsa ba'i bla ma la gsol ba 'debs/ /byin rlabs dngos grub chu rgyun gyis/ /bdag rgyud gang bar byin gyis rlobs/

/lus dag pa lha yi pho brang du/ /zhi khro rab 'byams la gsol ba 'debs/ /rang gdangs 'od kyi sgron me yis/ /rang gsal rtogs par byin gyis rlobs/ /ngag dag pa sngags kyi pho brang du/ /rtsa gnas 'khor lo la gsol ba 'debs/ /sna tshogs theg pa'i rang sgra yis/ / 'gro drug smin par byin gyis rlobs/ /sems dag pa chos sku'i pho brang du/ / gzhi rdzogs thugs la gsol ba 'debs/ /rang bzhin lhun grub kyi dgongs pa de/ /nang nas 'char bar byin gyis rlobs/ /de ltar bla ma'i tshogs rnams la/ /sgo gsum dang bas phyag 'tshal lo/ /mchod pa'i sprin gyi phung po mchod/ /sdig pa'i tshogs kun rab bshags te/ /dge ba kun la rjes yi rang*/ /chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba dang*/ /mya ngan mi 'da' rtag bzhugs nas/ /thugs rjes spyan gyis dgongs su gsol/ /las ngan sdig sgrib dag par byin gyis rlobs/ /rkyen ngan grogs su 'char bar byin gyis rlobs/ / 'khor ba'i zhen pa bzlog par byin gyis rlobs/ /skyo shas gting nas skye bar byin gyis rlobs/ /ci bsam chos su 'grub par byin gyis rlobs/ /chos phyogs dka' spyad nus par byin gyis rlobs/ /snang ba chos skur 'char bar byin gyis rlobs/ /chos nyid zad sar 'khyol bar byin gyis rlobs/ /gzhan don lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs/ /mthong thos bde la 'god par byin gyis rlobs/ /mdor na ci bsam 'grub par byin gyis rlobs/ / gsol 'debs bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun zhes bya ba/ dpal ku ma rā dza'i zhabs kyi padmo dri ma med pa la gtugs shing*/ thugs kyis bzung ba'i rnal 'byor pa byar med klong yangs kyis/ mchims phu dpal gyi nags khrod/ rang byung padma'i bzhugs gnas su sbyar ba rdzogs so// //dge'o/ /dge'o// // mes po'i shul bzhag las/ klong chen rab 'byams kyi gsung 'bum/ (11)gsol 'debs bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun/ - PAGE 26
